shortDescription: Manage storage groups on PowerMax or VMAX Storage System

options.name: child_sg_state
options.description: Describes the state of CSG inside parent SG.

options.name: child_storage_groups
options.description: This is a list of child storage groups.

options.name: compression
options.description: Compression on storage group. Compression parameter is ignored if service_level is not specified. Default is true.

options.name: force
options.description: This flag is to be set to True while moving volumes to target SG if volume is in a masking view.

options.name: host_io_limit
options.description: Host I/O limit of the storage group.

options.name: new_sg_name
options.description: The new name of the storage group.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: rdf_auto_resolve_target
options.description: When true, automatically queries the array to discover the actual remote storage group name. Ignored if I(rdf_target_sg_name) is specified. Applicable only for SRDF-protected storage groups.

options.name: rdf_target_sg_name
options.description: The name of the remote (R2) storage group on the target array. Used when the R2 storage group has a different name from the R1 (source) storage group. If not specified and I(rdf_auto_resolve_target) is false, the R1 storage group name is used. Applicable only for SRDF-protected storage groups.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax/VMAX array. It is a required parameter for all array-specific operations except for getting a list of arrays in the Gatherfacts module.

options.name: service_level
options.description: The name of SLO.

options.name: sg_name
options.description: The name of the storage group.

options.name: snapshot_policies
options.description: List of snapshot policies.

options.name: snapshot_policy_state
options.description: Describes the state of snapshot policy for an SG.

options.name: srp
options.description: The name of the storage resource pool. This parameter is ignored if service_level is not specified. Default is to use whichever is the default SRP on the array.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the storage group should exist or not.

options.name: target_sg_name
options.description: The destination SG name to move the volumes to.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.

options.name: vol_state
options.description: Describes the state of volumes inside the SG.

options.name: volumes
options.description: This is a list of volumes. Each volume has four attributes; vol_name, size, cap_unit, vol_id. Volume ID must be provided for existing volumes. The size must be provided to add new volumes to SG. The cap_unit is optional. Default value of cap_unit is GB, choices are MB, GB, TB.
